milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the pink concrete powder block (placed at spawn-relative [6, 0, 8], at ground level beside the oak hut) and face toward it, confirming they have located and can see the block. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to visually identify the block, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it rather than facing away. Target is at y=0 (ground level) because pink concrete powder is gravity-affected and falls to the surface — confirmed via sandbox gravity test.

scene_description: A small outdoor area with two structures (oak planks hut and cobblestone building), a white concrete platform with flower pot, and animals for visual interest. The pink concrete powder block is placed at ground level behind/beside the oak hut, requiring the player to explore around the structure to find it. The block is not visible from spawn but is within ~10 blocks walking distance.
task_text: Find the pink concrete powder block hidden somewhere in this area. Look around the structures carefully.
design_notes: Pink concrete powder placed at ~6 ~0 ~8 (ground level, on top of grass). This is beside/behind the oak hut (which spans ~3-5 x, ~6-8 z). The block is at ground level to avoid gravity issues. Player spawns at origin facing roughly north — the pink block is ~10 blocks away (6 east, 8 north) behind the oak structure. The cobblestone building at (-6 to -4, -3 to -1) and white platform at (-2 to 0, 3 to 5) serve as distractors and landmarks.
